user.title: Set up HeatWise
user.description: Only the name is required. Everything else is optional and can be changed later.

data_description.boiler_entity: Optional. Leave empty for a house heated only by air conditioners.
data_description.house_temp_sensor: Optional. Without it the thermostat's own reading is used.
data_description.persons: Optional. Without people HeatWise assumes someone is home.
data_description.schedule_entity: Optional. A Schedule helper works best. Without it: comfort while someone is home.

equipment.title: Boiler and air conditioner
equipment.description: All optional. The numbers are on the datasheet or the energy label. Whatever you leave empty, HeatWise replaces with an average for that kind of device; you can fill it in later from Configure.

data_description.boiler_model: Only for you to remember, e.g. Beretta Quadra Green 25 CSI.
data_description.boiler_power_kw: Heating, not hot water. Gives the first guess of gas per burner hour.
data_description.boiler_efficiency_pct: The full-load value against Hi, e.g. 97.5. Condensing boilers show more than 100 % at low load.
data_description.ac_heat_w: Rated heating capacity, e.g. 3399 W. Together with the power input it gives the AC efficiency (COP).
data_description.ac_input_w: Rated power consumption when heating, e.g. 916 W.
data_description.ac_energy_class: Used only if the two numbers above are empty.

hybrid.title: Air conditioner and prices
hybrid.description: HeatWise picks the cheaper source when both prices are known, otherwise it uses the outdoor threshold. Gas billed in m³: 1 m³ ≈ 10.5 kWh.

data.ac_threshold: Use the AC above this outdoor temperature (without prices)
data.gas_price: Gas price per kWh (if no sensor)
data.electricity_price: Electricity price per kWh (if no sensor)

power.title: Boiler power plug
power.description: A smart plug with power measurement on the boiler shows when the burner runs. With it HeatWise also estimates the gas used and its cost.

data_description.gas_meter_entity: A sensor with the meter index in m³, e.g. from your gas supplier's integration or a pulse counter. HeatWise learns the real gas use per burner hour from every new reading.
data_description.gas_rate: Starting value until HeatWise learns it from the meter. A 24 kW boiler burns up to about 2.5 m³/h.
data_description.gas_kwh_per_m3: Written on the gas bill (calorific value); about 10.5 kWh in Romania.
